---
title: "Landscape Integrity"
abstract: Landscape integrity, derived from habitat fragmentation and connectivity metrics, provides a means to assess the resilience of a landscape in consrevation. In conservation planning assessing connectivty in the form of corridors is particularly important.
title-block-banner: true
bibliography: references.bib

A modification coverage is used to identify natural, near-natural, and functional areas. **2**. By applying a resistance surface of species movement through the modified landscape, **3**. a fragmentation analysis can be performed, to **4**. identify corridors for species movement, and areas with good landscape integritiy, i.e., high connectivity, sufficient number and size of habitat patches. @coreteam2025rv4 packages 'landscapemetrics' [@hesselbarth2019lao] was used to analyse landscape integrity, and 'gdistance' [@vanetten2017rpg] to estimate least-cost paths, and 'grainscape' [@chubaty2025glc] to evaluate graph connectivity.
